candidate.claim: ALB multi-value headers are joined with '; ' for all headers, corrupting list-based headers like x-forwarded-for which require ', ' joining.
candidate.title: ALB headers joined with wrong delimiter

verifier.reason: The ALBProcessor.getHeaders at adapter/aws-lambda/handler.ts:546-551 iterates every multiValueHeaders entry and unconditionally joins values with '; ' via values.join('; ') and headers.set, with no per-header delimiter distinction, so list-based headers such as x-forwarded-for are not comma-joined.

candidate.claim: ALB query-string builder interpolates raw keys and values without encodeURIComponent, producing invalid URLs for spaces, &, =, and non-ASCII unlike the V1 processor.
candidate.title: ALB query string not URL-encoded

verifier.reason: The ALB getQueryString at adapter/aws-lambda/handler.ts:585-595 interpolates raw keys and values via `${key}=${value.join(`&${key}=`)}` and `${key}=${value}` with no encodeURIComponent, so characters such as & and = in values would be parsed as delimiters.

candidate.claim: Lattice V2 processor ignores queryStringParameters entirely by returning empty string, dropping query parameters when path does not already contain them.
candidate.title: Lattice query string always empty

verifier.reason: LatticeV2Processor.getPath returns only event.path at adapter/aws-lambda/handler.ts:626-628 and getQueryString takes no event argument and unconditionally returns '' at adapter/aws-lambda/handler.ts:634-636, so queryStringParameters are never incorporated into the request URL.
